units.source_text: 叶子头上包着毛巾，大概没看见岛村吧。

en.t: With a towel wrapped around her head, Yoko probably did not notice Shimamura.

units.source_text: 她叉开穿着雪裤的双腿，一边打红小豆，

en.t: She stood with her legs spread in snow trousers, beating red beans,

units.source_text: 一边唱歌，歌声清彻得近乎悲戚，马上就能引起回声似的。

en.t: and singing; her voice was so clear it was almost sorrowful, as if it might call up an echo at once.
